intent: Create a MELEK account on testnet (alpha) or mainnet. Keys are generated in the browser and only public keys are sent.
phrasings: how do i make a melek account
how to creat an acount on melek salon
i want a testnet account to try stuff
can you make me an account?
prerequisites: A modern browser
Somewhere safe to store a text file or password (offline is best)
Mainnet only: an invite may be required (Witness School says 'invite-gated'). The testnet faucet has an INVITE_REQUIRED switch that ships OFF.

steps.do: Type a name in 'Account name' (3–16 chars, lowercase letters/numbers/hyphens, must start with a letter), then click 'Generate my keys'
steps.why: The page checks the name is free using condenser_api.get_accounts over /rpc, then makes the master password and 4 keys in the browser

steps.do: Click '⬇ Download my keys' or use any 'Copy' button to save the master password and keys
steps.why: Step 1 of the gate. 'Create my account' stays locked until the keys are saved.

steps.do: Re-type the master password in the 'paste or type your master password' box
steps.why: Step 2 of the gate proves you kept the password

steps.do: Click 'Create my account'
steps.why: The browser POSTs only the name and 4 PUBLIC keys to /faucet/create, and the faucet broadcasts the account creation

steps.do: Optional: click 'Verify you saved it right'. Enter 'Account name' and 'The string you saved', then click 'Check (stays in your browser)'
steps.why: Confirms the saved secret matches the on-chain public keys. The check never leaves the browser.

steps.do: Click 'Continue to Welcome →', then 'Log in' with the account name and master password
steps.why: Within minutes Hathor's welcomer delegates POWER (RC), sends a 5–15 TESTS/MELEK grant and @-mentions you on the Welcome post

steps.do: MAINNET variant: open the wallet signup link and follow the same page (it detects a non-alpha host and uses the MELEK key prefix and the melek.salon login)
steps.why: account-ui.mjs switches network by hostname; the mainnet faucet uses claim_account + create_claimed_account + delegate_vesting_shares

touches: testnet: signup/faucet-testnet.mjs account_create (creator initminer, fee 0.001 TESTS, prefix TST)
mainnet: signup/faucet-mainnet.mjs claim_account + create_claimed_account (creator hathor) + delegate_vesting_shares
witness/welcomer.mjs: delegate_vesting_shares + transfer 5–15 + a comment ping on the Welcome post (signed by hathor via MELEK-Signer or a JIT key)
keys: The master password and the owner/active/posting/memo private keys are generated in the user's browser (graphene-keys.mjs) and only ever stored by the user. The server receives the name and PUBLIC keys only, and the faucet rejects anything shaped like a private key. The faucet's creator key signs the account creation server-side. Hathor never asks for, sees or stores any user key.
pitfalls: Reloading the page makes a brand-new key set and resets the gate
There is no password recovery. Lose the master password and the account is gone unless an older key backup exists
Testnet keys start with TST and mainnet keys start with MELEK; they are not interchangeable
Names must be 3–16 chars and lowercase; taken names are rejected
Rate limit: the faucet answers 429 'rate-limited' after too many creates per IP or fingerprint
Never paste keys into chat (including Hathor's)
notes: The testnet page code is verified, but which Caddy path serves site/alpha/account/* (assumed /account/) was not confirmed in the Bot repo. Mainnet: many sites link to https://wallet.melek.salon/signup and Caddy redirects there, but the redirect target lives in the condenser/Caddy config, not in this repo. Mainnet behaviour is inferred from account-ui.mjs host detection plus faucet-mainnet.mjs. A staged register.html (site/signup-pages) is a design for the condenser and is not live. Mainnet invite gating: run page says invite-gated, but faucet-mainnet.mjs has no invite check.

intent: Sign in to one of our sites (Congress, Auto-Vote, Pentecaust and its sibling sites) using 'Login with MELEK' through MELEK-Signer.
phrasings: how do i log in with melek
how to connect my melek account to autovote
do i give you my password to log in?
prerequisites: An existing MELEK account plus its master password

steps.do: Click 'Post', a like (♡) or a reply (💬). Without a session the page redirects you to MELEK-Signer.
steps.why: Congress sends you to signer /oauth2/authorize?client_id=congress&scope=vote comment&redirect_uri=<page>

steps.do: Enter your MELEK account name and password on the signer page and approve
steps.why: The signer checks the password against the on-chain keys and redirects back with ?code=

steps.do: Back on the site you see 'Posting as @you'
steps.why: The page exchanges the code at signer /oauth2/token and stores a bearer token in localStorage (congress_tok)

steps.do: Auto-Vote variant: choose 'Chain', open the MELEK-Signer tab, click 'Login with MELEK ›'
steps.why: /melek-signer/login redirects to the hosted signer (scope 'vote'); /melek-signer/callback stores the token

steps.do: Pentecaust variant: in the 'Sign in:' bar click 'Login with MELEK', then answer the two prompts ('Your MELEK @name:' and 'Your MELEK password:')
steps.why: Pentecaust POSTs the account and password to /auth/method/melek-signer, which forwards them to the signer for verification

keys: The user types the MELEK password only on the signer page (Congress and Auto-Vote redirect flow). On Pentecaust the password is entered in a browser prompt on pentecaust.com and sent to Pentecaust's server, which forwards it to the signer and does not log it. The site keeps only a revocable bearer token. The Auto-Vote page says 'the signer holds your keys and votes on your behalf'. Hathor never sees the password.
pitfalls: Always check that the address bar shows signer.melek.salon before typing a password (SECURITY.md warns about phishing clones of signer pages)
Pentecaust asks for the password in a browser prompt on pentecaust.com, not on the signer
Congress is TESTNET (alpha), so use a testnet account there
Pentecaust 'One-time code' needs email delivery, which is not wired yet; the UI says to use Login with MELEK or Google instead
Bearer tokens act for you within their scope; log out and revoke them when done
Sibling Pentecaust sites (Pact, Herald, Connect) use "Sign in with MELEK" via pentecaust.com /auth/sso; pact.pentecaust.com answered HTTP 502 on 2026-10-17.
notes: The signer UI and how it holds or derives user keys live in the private MELEK-Signer repo, so the exact signer page labels are unverified. Witness School lists signer /health and /oauth2/authorize as answering (site/witness/server.mjs:2215). vote.melek.salon is mapped to autovote/server.js from the live Caddy config, not from this repo.

intent: Work through the 19-stage MELEK onboarding tutorial and check progress.
phrasings: how do i progress in the tutorial
whats my next step on melek
how do i know i finished a stage
prerequisites: A MELEK account for stages 1+ (stage 0 is creating it)

steps.do: Open "Your path on MELEK" (testnet tutorial) and tap a stage to see what it is and how to do it
steps.why: Self-paced map; ticks are saved in your browser only

steps.do: In Chat with Hathor type "!tutorial yourname" (or tap "!help") and Send
steps.why: Reads your real on-chain progress and the next unlock

steps.do: Do the stage on the testnet (post, comment, power up, vote...), then ask "!tutorial yourname" again
steps.why: Hathor reacts on-chain

stages: 1 intro_post (A): top-level post tagged introduceyourself/introduction/introducing, body ≥200 chars
2 engage_three_posts (A): ≥3 comments on 3 different other authors, each ≥80 chars
3 share_what_you_know (A): a post ≥800 chars, not tagged introduceyourself/introduction
4 first_organic_upvote (A): ≥1 upvote received from someone other than hathor
7 set_profile (A): profile has name, about or profile_image
8 follow_three_authors (A): follow ≥3 distinct accounts (custom_json 'follow'), not yourself
9 send_first_transfer (A): transfer ≥0.001 MELEK to someone else
10 delegate_some_mp (A): delegate ≥1.000 MP to someone else
13 create_a_token (B, infra-gated): hold or create ≥1 SMT-style token
19 become_a_node_of_the_network (C): welcome ≥1 newcomer whose account is newer than yours
keys: Only reads happen here. Each stage's on-chain action is signed by the user in their own front-end/signer. Hathor never holds user keys.
pitfalls: The alpha tutorial page's checkboxes are local self-marks, not chain-verified
Tier B stages cannot be completed yet ('Coming soon')
Stage 4 does not count Hathor's own upvote
Self-transfers, self-delegations and self-follows do not count
notes: live page check 2026-10-17: alpha tutorial + chat pages 200. tutorial.soapbox.community (404) dropped.

steps.do: Read Witness School: what a witness is, and the path learn → run a node → register → get votes
steps.why: Orientation

steps.do: Pick a server (honest hardware pointers)
steps.why: Step 1 · Get a box

steps.do: Clone github.com/HinduTempleCoins/melek-chain, run cmake with -DBUILD_STEEM_TESTNET=OFF, then make steemd cli_wallet
steps.why: Step 2 · Build the node (OFF = mainnet)

steps.do: In cli_wallet run suggest_brain_key to make a dedicated block-signing key
steps.why: Step 3; only this signing key lives on the box

steps.do: Write config.ini (p2p-endpoint 0.0.0.0:2003, the p2p-seed-node shown on the page, witness = "youraccount", private-key = signing WIF, plugins listed) and start ./steemd --data-dir=/opt/melek
steps.why: Steps 4–5 · Sync and produce

steps.do: In an unlocked cli_wallet run update_witness "youraccount" "<url>" "<signing PUB>" {props} true
steps.why: Step 6 · Register (needs your account's active key in cli_wallet)

steps.do: Post an intro thread, share your uptime and ask holders for votes

BUILD_STEEM_TESTNET must be OFF for mainnet
Do not put owner/active keys in config.ini

intent: Mine ZEPH or XMR-stagenet in the browser tab on the SoapBox pool
phrasings: how do i mine in my browser
can i mine on my phone?
whats the 5 second miner on the pool
how do I pick which wallet gets paid when mining
prerequisites: A modern browser (a phone works too)
A ZEPH or XMR receive address, or make one in one tap from the wallet tiles

steps.do: Scroll to the card 'Start mining in 5 seconds — no install, even on your phone'
steps.why: This is the in-browser RandomX miner (section #browser-mine)

steps.do: Under 'Mine to your wallet', tap a coloured wallet tile you already have, or a grey dashed tile to make one (ZEPH is shown first). To use an outside wallet, tap the small 'use my own wallet' tile and fill 'Paste your own address'
steps.why: The tile you pick fills in the payout address. Only the public address is sent, as the mining username

steps.do: Set the 'How hard to push' slider (5–100%, default 50%)
steps.why: Lower keeps the device cooler and saves battery

steps.do: Press '▶ Start mining'
steps.why: Starts the RandomX worker, which sends shares to the pool over the /ws bridge

steps.do: Watch Status, Hashrate, 'Accepted shares' and Threads. Press '■ Stop' when you are done
steps.why: Mining stops if you close the tab or move it to the background

touches: pool/www browser-mine.mjs + miner-worker (RandomX in the browser)
keys: The pool only ever sees the public receive address (used as the stratum username). Wallet secrets made on the tiles stay in the user's browser. Hathor never sees or asks for any secret.
pitfalls: Browser mining is slow: about 8–10 H/s per core on a computer, less on a phone. Earnings are fractions of a cent a day
On phones, keep it plugged in and use the throttle
Ad-blockers may hide the miner. Allow the page or use the download launcher
The Monero side is STAGENET. A mainnet XMR address is converted to its stagenet twin automatically (poolLoginAddress)
notes: index.html:102-107 says ZEPH browser mining is LIVE on mainnet. wizard.mjs:95 still has the ZEPH launcher entry enabled:false (affects the desktop launcher menu only).

intent: Point xmrig (CPU) or a GPU miner at the SoapBox pool / PRANA Etchash stratum
phrasings: what's the stratum address for the pool
how do i point my rig at your pool
what do i put as username in xmrig
prerequisites: xmrig (CPU, RandomX) or lolMiner/T-Rex/GMiner (GPU, Etchash)
A payout address: XMR/ZEPH for RandomX, or an EVM 0x address for PRANA/ETC

steps.do: Under 'Or pick one coin at a time', click the coin to open its detail panel
steps.why: The panel lists the live stratum ports and copy-paste miner commands

steps.do: In the panel's 'Let us set it up for you' wizard, paste the address into 'Your <coin> wallet address (this is who gets paid)' to get a ready-made config/start script. Or copy the 'Mine with xmrig' line: xmrig -o pool.soapbox.community:4444 -u YOUR_XMR_ADDRESS -p worker1 -a rx/0
steps.why: 4444 is the Monero (stagenet) CPU port. The -u address is your payout address. The pool never holds your keys

steps.do: Optional: in 'Want real earnings? Download the SoapBox Miner', enter the XMR and/or 0x address and click '⬇ Windows (.bat + .ps1)' or '⬇ Linux / macOS (.sh)'
steps.why: Builds a launcher with the stagenet-converted login already baked in

steps.do: For PRANA (GPU, Etchash): set the pool to stratum+tcp://pool.soapbox.community:3333 and the user to 0xYOUR_PRANA_ADDRESS.rig1 (lolMiner --algo ETCHASH / t-rex -a etchash / gminer --algo etchash)
steps.why: /mine sets out the three things to configure: stratum URL, a public 0x payout address, and a worker name

steps.do: Check your shares and balance by address (or use the live status at /pool)
steps.why: Read-only lookup by public address

touches: Miningcore stratum on pool.soapbox.community (4444 XMR-stagenet CPU, 4447 ZEPH, 5550 ETC-Mordor GPU, 3333 PRANA Etchash)
keys: The miner config holds only a PUBLIC address. Hathor must never ask for a seed or private key. The user's wallet keeps its own keys.
pitfalls: The XMR side is stagenet. A mainnet 4… address is rejected at stratum login unless you use the pool-generated kit (which converts it to the stagenet twin)
Etchash needs a GPU. CPU mining PRANA/ETC is not practical
PRANA port 3333 is an env default (PRANA_STRATUM_PORT). The live ports are shown in the coin panel
Ports per coin come from the live /api/pools. If none are shown, the panel says 'Stratum ports are being provisioned'
notes: ZEPH port 4447 is in config but launcher.enabled:false at wizard.mjs:95.

intent: Generate a ZEPH/XMR/EVM wallet in the pool page, back it up, and see balances on My Coins
phrasings: how do i make a wallet on the pool
where do i see my mined coins
how do i claim my xmr with my seed
lost my pool wallet can you recover it
prerequisites: Pen and paper (or an offline place) for the recovery phrase

steps.do: On the coin's card under 'Your wallets', click '✦ Generate a wallet here' (or '＋ Paste an address I have', then 'Save address')
steps.why: The wallet is created on your device. The pool stores nothing

steps.do: Read the warning, then click '👁 Reveal my backup (once)'. Write down the 'Recovery phrase (25 words)' (or the 'Private key' for EVM). Optionally click '⬇ Download backup (.txt)'
steps.why: The secret is shown once and never leaves the browser

steps.do: Type the requested words in 'Confirm you wrote it down — type words …' and click '✓ Confirm & save this wallet' (EVM: tick 'I have saved my private key offline…' then '✓ Save this wallet')
steps.why: Checks that your paper backup is correct

steps.do: Optional: choose a password and click '🔐 Encrypt & keep a copy here', or 'Skip — paper backup only'
steps.why: An AES-256-GCM encrypted copy kept in this browser. Nobody can reset the password

steps.do: Open My Coins (top nav 'My Coins'). Each coin card shows 'Total pending', 'paid', H/s and workers per address. You can also add coins here with '✦ Generate a new wallet' / '＋ Paste an address I already have'
steps.why: Live pool stats for your saved addresses

steps.do: To spend or claim payouts, restore the same 25-word phrase in your own Monero wallet. Use stagenet mode for the XMR-stagenet pool
steps.why: The pool logs you in with the stagenet twin of your mainnet address: same keys, same seed

keys: The seed/private key is generated and shown ONLY in the user's browser. The pool and Hathor never receive it and cannot recover it. Only the public receive address leaves the device.
pitfalls: The phrase is shown once. If it is lost, the coins are gone and nobody can recover it
Sending from the browser wallet does NOT exist yet. 'Outflow approval' / '↗ Send' are placeholders until PRANA/Akasha
XMR payouts are stagenet coins while the pool is testing
Saved wallets live in this browser's localStorage. Clearing site data removes them (the paper backup still works)
notes: 'Claim with the mnemonic in stagenet mode' is stated only in a code comment (wizard.mjs:186-188). No UI step walks the user through restoring in an external wallet, and no specific external wallet is named.

Your own PRANA (EVM) address, e.g. MetaMask; for the way back, an EVM wallet holding wVKBT/wCURE and some PRANA for gas

steps.why: Hive → PRANA

steps.do: Enter your own PRANA address (where wVKBT/wCURE arrives) - double-check it is yours
steps.why: The memo is the only destination

steps.do: Tap "Send via Hive Keychain" and approve: Keychain sends your tokens to @kula-bridge with your PRANA address as the memo
steps.why: Custody is the 3-of-5 @kula-bridge

steps.do: Wait 12 confirmations; the relayer mints wVKBT/wCURE to your PRANA address. Then use it on KulaSwap like any PRANA token
steps.why: Mint on PRANA (chainId 712217)

steps.why: Destination = the username you sign

steps.why: approve + withdraw(bytes32,uint256,bytes32)

pitfalls: Put ONLY your PRANA address in the deposit memo - the bridge page fills it for you
Wait the 12 confirmations before checking
Verify the contract addresses on the page before approving

keys: The recovery page never accepts a password or key. Keys are entered only on MELEK-Signer's own sign-in page. There is no password reset unless MELEK-Signer already holds the account's keys.
pitfalls: Recovery is optional and runs only through MELEK-Signer
After 30 days, or with no recovery partner, a stolen account cannot be reversed
If MELEK-Signer does not hold your keys, a lost password cannot be reset
Never type a password or key into any page or chat other than the MELEK-Signer sign-in page
notes: All recover-account links (account pages, wallet side panel/change-password, wallet /recover_account_step_*) point to the MELEK-Signer recovery guide.
